items.title: Malicious MCP Servers Can Split Instructions to Make AI Coding Agents Exfiltrate Secrets
items.summary: A malicious tool server connected to an AI coding assistant can quietly walk off with SSH keys, environment secrets, source code, and customer data without ever sending one obviously harmful instruction.
